description: Random voltage generator that steps to a new value at a rate you set and glides to it, with five outputs each drawn from a different distribution

params.text: Sets how often a new value is drawn, in steps a second; the module clamps it at 4 a second, so everything above 4 on the dial behaves the same
Sets the shape parameter used for every draw the module makes, 0.0001 to 1
Chooses the distribution the step length is drawn from
Sets how far the drawn step length pushes the rate away from the rate knob, from not at all to the full amount

inputs.text: Raises the step rate, 1V adding two steps a second, with the total held between 0.01 and 4 a second
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the shape parameter comes from its knob alone
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the step distribution comes from its switch alone
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the modulation depth comes from its knob alone

outputs.text: A random voltage gliding from the last value to the new one, ±5V, drawn from a uniform distribution despite the jack being named for the Cauchy one
A random voltage gliding from the last value to the new one, ±5V, drawn from a Cauchy distribution despite the jack being named for the logistic one
A random voltage gliding from the last value to the new one, ±5V, drawn from a logistic distribution despite the jack being named for the hyperbolic one
A random voltage gliding from the last value to the new one, ±5V, drawn from a hyperbolic distribution despite the jack being named for the arcsine one
A random voltage gliding from the last value to the new one, ±5V, drawn from an arcsine distribution despite the jack being named for the exponential one
A 1ms 10V pulse each time a new set of values is drawn

notes: the module runs on its own and needs no clock; it draws its first set of values as soon as it is placed.

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
